P1: When you return to Elm's Lab in 若叶镇, 琴音/响 is impressed that you have already collected eight Badges, and Professor Elm thanks you for helping with his research. To show his appreciation, he rewards you with a 大师球, a rare model of Poké Ball that catches any Pokémon without fail! According to Elm, this type of Poké Ball is usually given only to recognized Pokémon researchers, but he thinks that you will make better use of it than he would. It is best to use it when battling a Legendary Pokémon, as they can be very difficult to capture otherwise. He also informs you that a group of Kimono Girls is looking for you, and is waiting at the Ecruteak Dance Theater.
P2: As you approach the Dance Theater, 劲敌（西尔弗） is just leaving, still agonizing over his defeat by the Kimono Girls. He warns you not to get complacent just because you defeated Team Rocket, as the Kimono Girls are powerful Trainers. He leaves quickly so that he does not have to see you win where he could not.
P3: Once inside, you proceed to the stage, where you are welcomed by Zuki. She explains that in order to persuade 凤王 / 洛奇亚 to return, they needed to find a person who has the right bond with Pokémon. She reveals that it was they who gave the 神奇蛋 to Mr. Pokémon, and asked that he give it to someone who showed "true potential". However, pure intentions alone will not be enough to face the Legendary Pokémon's power. Zuki then gives you a chance to prove yourself by defeating each of the sisters in quick succession.
P4: Zuki, the girl from 桔梗市, intends to test how closely you have bonded with your Pokémon.
P5: Naoko, who you first met in 桐树林, witnessed you taking on Team Rocket when Kurt was in trouble.
P6: Miki saw you chase off the Team Rocket Grunt who was harassing her here, in the Dance Theater.
P7: Sayo, the girl who skates in sandals, witnessed your kindness when you helped her escape the 冰雪小径. She was in the 龙穴, and overheard your answers to the Elder's quiz.
P8: Kuni, the girl you met in Goldenrod Tunnel, was amazed when you thwarted Team Rocket's mission to take over the Radio Tower.
P9: Defeating the five sisters proves your worth, and Zuki entrusts you with the 透明铃铛 / 海声铃铛. When paired with the Rainbow Wing / Silver Wing, these two legendary artifacts summon the Legendary Pokémon to its roost.
P10: Just then, the girls' younger sister runs into the building. She exclaims that she just saw the shadow of a big Pokémon, over the 铃铛塔 / in the 漩涡岛' waters. The sisters all rush off to investigate, leaving you to follow.
P11: Bellchime Trail is a short path between the Barrier Station and the 铃铛塔. It is said to always be bathed in sunset, no matter the season.
D1:
* North of the path, between the second and third trees from the west (hidden)
* North of the path, between the third and fourth trees from the west (hidden)
* Next to the Bell Tower's northwest corner (hidden)
D2:
* North-central area, between the fifth and sixth trees from the west (hidden)
* South of the Bell Tower (hidden)
P12: The 铃铛塔 is a sacred place, and is off-limits to all but a select few people. Ecruteak Gym's 迷雾徽章 gets a Trainer inside the tower, but no higher than the first floor. Possessing the Rainbow Wing and the 透明铃铛 proves your worth as a Trainer, and together grant access to the rest of the tower.
P13: Only HeartGold players can complete this section at this point. SoulSilver players obtain the Rainbow Wing later and thus should skip to the next section, and come back later. The Clear Bell is not required in SoulSilver, and cannot be obtained anyway.
D5: North-central area, on the eastbound ramp (hidden)
D7: East of the pillar, left-hand path
D12: East-southeast area, north of the stairs to 4F (hidden)
D19: Center; next to the pillar, accessed via warp panel on 9F
D20: South; southeast of the pillar, accessed via warp panel on 9F
D21: North; in the patch of light under the easternmost window (hidden)
D24: North; between the two central statues, accessed via warp panel on 8F
P14: Approach the ladder in the northwest, and the Rainbow Wing floats up into the air above you for a moment. Seeing this legendary artifact, the Sage standing guard allows you to continue up the tower.
P15: Beginning on the third floor, the tower features a series of ramps to confound any intruders looking to use the Legendary Pokémon for nefarious deeds. Pick up the 万灵药 in the southwest corner, then move around the floor in a large S-shape to reach the stairs in the northeast.
P16: Go south and jump the first ramp, then take the western path to reach an 高级球. Continue southward and pick up the ＰＰ提升剂 in the southeast corner. Head west to reach an 离洞绳, then climb the northwest stairs.
P17: Jump over the two ramps along the north wall to reach the northeast corner, then move south and west to find a 神奇糖果 at the central pillar. Take the southeast path to reach the stairs in the southeast corner.
P18: Move westward to the southwest area, then pass by the pillar again and climb the northwest ladder.
P19: Jump eastward over the first two ramps, then jump the one to the south. Move westward over the next ramp, then turn south and take the eastern path to reach the south-central ladder.
P20: The sixth floor serves as a transition between the tightly-packed ramps on the lower floors and the far-flung warp panels above. Collect the 全满药 next to the pillar, then move counter-clockwise along the path to find a 万灵药 in the northwest corner. Head southward over the two ramps to reach the western stairs.
P21: Step on the northern warp panel to reach the central area, then take the next one to reach the eastern part of 9F. There are two warp panels to the south. Take the one on the right first; this leads to the dead-end central part of 8F and a ＰＰ多项全补剂. The one on the left leads to the dead-end southeastern part of 8F and a 金珠. Backtrack to the northern warp panel on 7F, then pick up the 活力块 in the northeast corner. Head south and take the southern warp panel to the west side of 8F.
P22: Step on the southern warp panel to reach the north side of 9F. Collect the ＨＰ增强剂 near the north wall, then take the western warp panel to the north side of 8F. Once there, pick up the 全复药 in the northwest corner, then step on the north-central warp panel to be transported to the central part of 9F.
P24: Cross the bridge and climb up the final ladder to reach the rooftop.
C1: 虹色之羽 Ho-Oh Descends to the Bell Tower
C2: Zuki and the other Kimono Girls are waiting here for you. She explains that the dance that they have long practiced and the chime of the 透明铃铛 are parts of a ritual to summon 凤王 from the great arch of the sky once again. The Clear Bell then floats up into the air above you and the girls take their positions around the tower's spire. The Clear Bell and the four bells attached to the tower begin to chime, and the girls begin to dance as a flurry of sunset-colored leaves blows through the area. The sound reaches into the sky, and Ho-Oh descends to the rooftop a moment later. Zuki says that your heart and the Clear Bell in harmony have caused it to appear, and that it must have been waiting for someone like you all this time.
P25: The rainbow-colored 凤王 has returned to its perch! Begin with 水- and 电 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 格斗-, 火-, 钢-, 草-, and 虫 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P26: The 漩涡岛 are connected underwater by a sprawling network of dark caves, where seawater and boulders restrict movement in certain areas. Despite being first seen on the initial visit to 41号道路, it was impossible to fully explore the area without the field moves 冲浪, 怪力, and 潮旋, and difficult to do so without 闪光, as well. Visitors may enter from any of the four islands, but those looking for the immense, silver-colored Pokémon should enter from the northeast island. Possessing the Silver Wing and the 海声铃铛 prove your worth as a Trainer, and together grant access to a secluded chamber deep below sea level.
P27: Only SoulSilver players can complete this section at this point. HeartGold players obtain the Silver Wing later and thus should skip to the next section, and come back later. The Tidal Bell is not required in HeartGold, and cannot be obtained anyway.

P28: Use 闪光 to illuminate the area, then climb down the ladder.
P29: Go south from the ladder to reach a 速度增强剂, then climb down the ladder on the ridge to the southeast.
P30: Collect the two items, a ＰＰ多项全补剂 to the west and a 全复药 to the east, from atop the cliff and return to B1F.
P31: Head northwest to return to the first ladder, then go south from the rocky ridge to reach another 全复药 atop the ledge. Turn east and walk across the north-central ledge; walk down the second stairway and go left to find a 金珠. Head east and jump over the pair of ledges, then climb up the ladder.
P32: Pick up the 高级球 on the rocky ridge, then climb back down the same ladder.
P33: Go southwest from here, jumping over two ledges along the way. Grab the 离洞绳 in the south-central area. The nearby boulder cannot be moved from this side, so climb the ladder to the southwest instead. The entrance from the southwest island is located to the south.
P34: Use 冲浪 to move east from the entrance. Pick up the 高级球 and climb down the ladder.
P35: Go northeast, then south to reach the rocky ridge in the southeast area. Grab the 特攻增强剂 here and climb up the ladder.
P36: The entrance from the southeast island is located to the south.
P37: Jump over the first ledge, then continue eastward and jump the northern-most of the next two ledges. Climb down the ladder in the northeast corner.
P38: Move southwestward along the rocky ridge and climb down the next ladder.
P39: Collect the 活力块 to the west. Speak to the man at the cliff's edge, and the Silver Wing floats up into the air above you for a moment. Seeing this legendary artifact, the man steps aside, allowing you to continue down the cliffside. Walk down the ramp and enter the first cave opening.
P40: B3F houses a large waterfall basin. Collect the 神奇糖果 from the rocky overhang in this upper area and return to B2F.
P41: Continue along the path down the cliffside and enter the lower cave opening to reach the waterfall basin.
C3: 银色之羽 Lugia Rises from the Waterfall Basin
C4: Zuki and the other Kimono Girls are waiting here for you. She explains that the dance that they have long practiced and the chime of the 海声铃铛 are parts of a ritual to summon 洛奇亚 from the waterfall basin once again. The Tidal Bell then floats up into the air above you and the girls take their positions around the rocky platform. The Tidal Bell and the two bells on either side of the waterfall begin to chime, and the girls begin to dance as a flurry of silver-colored feathers blows through the area. A winged silhouette appears on the wall of water, and Lugia emerges a moment later. Zuki says that your heart and the Tidal Bell in harmony have caused it to appear, and that it must have been waiting for someone like you all this time.
P42: Walk down the stairway on the north side of the platform and use 冲浪 to reach the Legendary Pokémon.
P43: The silver-colored 洛奇亚 has appeared! Begin with 岩石-, 电-, 冰-, 幽灵-, and 恶 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 草-, 超能力-, and 格斗 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P44: There is no shortcut leading out of the cave, so using an Escape Rope is the fastest way to reach the exit.
P45: Entering from the southeast island ultimately leads to the southwest island's entrance. The only items accessible from this direction are a Calcium and a Ultra Ball, both of which will have been already obtained by this point.
